name: L-System Lab
desc: An L-system lab: rewrite rules and a turtle draw Koch, dragon, plant and Sierpinski fractals, with string length, segment count and fractal dimension shown live.
controls: Iteration and turn-angle sliders, four presets (Koch/dragon/plant/Sierpinski), grow/reset buttons; keys 1–4 load presets, Space grows, R resets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
